title: Plan a full local verification cycle after CI fails

rubric.text: The response switches from the failed CI check to the repository's complete locally available CI-equivalent verification before another push, rather than proposing a narrow fix followed by another CI wait
The response batches the CI repair with every other known actionable item and requires the complete local verification to pass before the single repair push
The response preserves the existing branch and remote-mutation boundaries because this evaluation authorizes analysis only
